definitions.explanation: Describes doing things quickly and efficiently, handling tasks one after another without delay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てきぱき⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
てきぱき⟦{動|うご}いて→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I moved briskly and finished the preparations.

examples.japanese: てきぱき⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
てきぱき has a positive connotation, implying competence and efficiency. It describes someone who works without wasting time or being confused.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- てきぱき⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work briskly
- てきぱき⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move briskly
- てきぱき⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an efficient person
- てきぱき⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to give instructions promptly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっさと→さっさと：05795_sassato⟧: quickly (sometimes impatient tone)
- ⟦きびきび→きびきび：05842_kibikibi⟧: briskly, energetically
- てきぱき implies more efficiency and capability than simple speed
